title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [Cognitive](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#Cognitive)
claim: Optimize your app’s UI for Assistive Access.** Assistive Access is an accessibility feature in iOS and iPadOS that allows people with cognitive disabilities to use a streamlined version of your app. Assistive Access sets a default layout and control presentation for apps that reduces cognitive load, such as the following layout of the Camera app.
